About Mr. Ratesh’s design

Your supplied SketchUp model is 16 feet wide, 7 feet high and up to 2 feet deep. The left wardrobe has handleless matte Daytona wood shutters, white interiors and the supplied rod/shelf arrangement, with no drawers.

The bay-window seat has a white cushion, a matte Daytona wood base and lift-up storage. The fixed lower section remains closed. The side door has rear-edge hinges and opens outward into the bay-window space, with apple hooks for shirts only behind it.

The tall cabinet has black frames, smoke-grey glass, a Daytona wood inner box, four Daytona wood shelves and warm-white lighting. The narrow section has three open glass shelves, Daytona wood backing/surround and warm-white lighting.

The wood grain uses your supplied ACE MICA sample (labelled Block Wall Salt, Design No. 1305), called Daytona wood in your brief. Exact panel thickness, frame profile, opening angles, cushion thickness, hook hardware/count and internal placements are visual approximations. Reference colours retains every extracted source face. Pricing has not been imported.
